title: Notice of reconsideration.
bodyText: Notice of a reconsideration upon a claim shall be promptly given to the parties by delivery thereof or by mailing the notice to the last known address of each party.
bodyHtml: [§392-81]  Notice of reconsideration.  Notice of a reconsideration upon a claim shall be promptly given to the parties by delivery thereof or by mailing the notice to the last known address of each party. [L 1969, c 148, pt of §1]
